request: Deploy merged and CI-verified Vault HMAC+Tunnel server via existing Compose. No GPG deletion or secret migration in this step.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
p=/home/admin1/projects/libral-vault
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = 899979380a1e8342441058c73682655702ca3b38
test -z "$(git -C "$p" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
cd "$p"
docker compose up -d --no-deps --build libral-vault
printf 'VAULT_RUNTIME_DEPLOY_SUBMITTED\n'
